text:
maria: FYI ran a perf sweep on the 8xA100 cluster this morning after the kernel-selector v3 rollout. small-batch (<=32 tokens) latencies up ~15% end-to-end. profile points to all-reduce stalls during KV lookup phases when KV cache is sharded across TP partitions. attaching quick log + notes below.

maria: key observations: TP-sharded KV reduces peak mem per-GPU but introduces frequent small all-reduces on KV indices; PP-local replication avoids those all-reduces but doubles cache memory and increases model state sync cost on rollouts. DP replication obviously avoids cross-GPU comm but is not viable for 4+ layer models due to memory.

maria: sample command used for profiling:
```
REPLICAS=8 ./tools/run_infer.sh --model redwood-13b --tp 2 --pp 2 --batch-pattern "mixed" --kernel-selector v3 
--trace perf_scope=kv,comm --profile flame 
```

maria: excerpt from flame output (trimmed):
```
[0.00-0.02s] compute_gemm
[0.02-0.05s] kv_read_remote_allreduce (wait)
[0.05-0.07s] kv_local_lookup
[0.07-0.09s] kv_write_prefetch
[0.09-0.12s] allreduce_kv_indices (small)
[0.12-0.18s] attn_forward
```

alex: can you paste the full flame/gist? want to check overlap windows. also which nccl proto was used on the cluster?

maria: gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood-inference/kv-tp-pp-run-176610 
maria: NCCL_PROTO=LL128 in that run, NCCL_ALGO=Ring

jordan: thanks — looks like the kernel-selector v3 switched to eager allreduce placement for small KV messages (to reduce tail latency on large batches). that explains regression for tiny batches.

li: quick thought: try moving to async prefetch + local cache hotset for PP lanes. if we prefetch KV shards into local buffer ahead of micro-batch, we can hide the all-reduce during compute. i can prototype a prefetch scheduler.

ben: another angle: batching heuristic should group requests by KV prefix similarity before microbatching. current mixed batching mixes keys which forces many small allreduces. We should bias the batcher to maximize prefix reuse when under TP-sharded mode. patch idea: add `batcher.kv_similarity_threshold` and order by prefix hash.

alex: +1 on both. also experiment: try NCCL_PROTO=Simple or enable NCCL_COLLNET for larger interconnects; see if reduced latency for repeated tiny allreduces. hw teams reported Tree/LL128 tradeoffs.

maria: ran quick micro-experiment: enabled prefetch in runtime (opt-in flag `--kv-prefetch=async`) + batcher bias to prefix. result: small-batch p95 improved 9% vs baseline v3, still 6% worse than v2. throughput unchanged.

jordan: could be kernel v3 changed the kernel launch ordering too — compute kernels now wait on completion of KV allreduce because we accidentally introduced an event sync in the cache read path. need to inspect runtime fences.

li: i'll grep for `cudaEventSynchronize` and `stream.synchronize` in cache codepath, but likely `recordEvent` got added to ensure ordering for a race. we can try `cudaStreamWaitEvent` instead and keep async progress.

sre-bot: perf-regression-alert: service=runtime-infer, deploy=2026-03-16T09:12Z, alert_id=PR-2026-0316-09, metric=small_batch_p95, delta=+14.8%

ben: for a short-term mitigator we could auto-fallback kernels for small-batch traffic to kernel-selector v2 behavior (explicit policy per model/route). add rollout config: `runtime.rollout.kernel_selector.policy.small_batch=fallback:v2`

maria: agreed. plan: 1) triage event/fence in KV read path (jordan + li) 2) prototype async prefetch scheduler (li) 3) tweak batcher to prefer prefix grouping (ben + alex) 4) add kernel-selector fallback knob in console (product + infra)

maria: volunteers? i'll take coord and run follow-up perf jobs tomorrow 06:00 PT. need 1 dev for prefetch prototype and 1 for batcher change.

alex: I can take batcher change, will open draft PR later today.

li: I'll own prefetch prototype, will post results in this thread.

jordan: i'll audit fences and kernel launch ordering, will ping if I find a sync.

maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
